 Wat ga je doen? 
Become a Production Worker at Renewi E-Waste in Dordrecht! 
Are you a hard worker looking for a job where you can truly make a difference? Would you like to earn an average gross monthly salary of €3,500 and are you willing to work in shifts? Then this position is for you! At Renewi E-Wastec in Dordrecht, we are looking for motivated production workers to join our team in recycling refrigerators, washing machines, and air conditioners. 
Job description: - Unload refrigerators from containers and place them on the conveyor belt; - Remove glass panels and properly separate materials; - Maintain a clean and organized workspace; - Occasionally assist other departments when needed. Waar ga je werken? 
About Renewi E-Waste 
At Coolrec, we are committed to a circular future by recovering high-quality raw materials from electrical appliances, plastics, and metals. Innovation, quality, and sustainability are at the heart of our mission. With five locations across three countries, we make an impact every day. As part of Renewi, we work by the motto: "Waste no more." 
Working at Renewi E-Waste in Dordrecht 
The Dordrecht location is easily accessible by car via the A15 or N3. Free parking and a covered bicycle shed are available on-site. From Dordrecht Central Station, it's about a 20-minute bike ride to the location. 
Please note: Due to shift work, public transport connections are limited. You will work in a fixed shift each week. 
Shift schedule: - Morning shift: 06:00 - 14:00 - Afternoon shift: 14:00 - 22:00 - Night shift: 22:00 - 06:00 Wie ben je? 
You are a go-getter, and physical work is no problem for you. Since you will be working in a three-shift system, having your own transportation is essential. Additionally, you: - Live in or near Dordrecht; - Are available full-time; - Speak Dutch or English. Wat mag je verwachten?
